name: svg-french-press-claude-opus-5.5-v2-s1-r3
prompt: Draw an exploded assembly diagram of a French press, as an SVG. Use the standard three-piece plunger filter rather than a two-piece travel press.

source.text:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="900" height="1420" viewBox="0 0 900 1420" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif">
<defs>
 <linearGradient id="steel" x1="0" x2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#8a9097"/><stop offset=".45" stop-color="#eef1f4"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#7c828a"/></linearGradient>
 <linearGradient id="glass" x1="0" x2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#cfe6f2" stop-opacity=".8"/><stop offset=".3" stop-color="#f4fbff" stop-opacity=".5"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#b9d8ea" stop-opacity=".8"/></linearGradient>
 <linearGradient id="black" x1="0" x2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#222"/><stop offset=".4" stop-color="#666"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#1a1a1a"/></linearGradient>
 <pattern id="mesh" width="4" height="4" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse"><path d="M0 0L4 4M4 0L0 4" stroke="#556" stroke-width=".6"/></pattern>
 <clipPath id="meshclip"><ellipse cx="350" cy="560" rx="96" ry="20"/></clipPath>
 <marker id="arr" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="5" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#c33"/></marker>
</defs>
<rect width="900" height="1420" fill="#fff"/>
<text x="450" y="38" text-anchor="middle" font-size="26" font-weight="bold">French Press — Exploded Assembly</text>
<text x="450" y="62" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" fill="#555">Standard plunger with three-piece filter (cross plate · mesh screen · spiral plate)</text>

<!-- centre axis -->
<line x1="350" y1="80" x2="350" y2="1400" stroke="#c33" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="14 4 3 4"/>

<!-- 1 Knob -->
<g stroke="#111" stroke-width="1.5">
 <rect x="344" y="128" width="12" height="14" fill="url(#steel)"/>
 <path d="M322 128 Q320 92 350 90 Q380 92 378 128 Z" fill="url(#black)"/>
 <ellipse cx="350" cy="128" rx="28" ry="5" fill="#333"/>
</g>

<!-- 2 Lid -->
<g stroke="#111" stroke-width="1.5">
 <path d="M238 210 Q250 168 350 164 Q450 168 462 210 Z" fill="url(#steel)"/>
 <ellipse cx="350" cy="210" rx="112" ry="14" fill="#c9ced3"/>
 <path d="M246 212 L246 226 Q350 246 454 226 L454 212" fill="url(#steel)"/>
 <rect x="343" y="160" width="14" height="8" fill="#555"/>
 <path d="M430 196 q14 -4 22 6" fill="none" stroke="#333"/>
</g>

<!-- 3 Plunger rod -->
<g stroke="#111" stroke-width="1.2">
 <rect x="346" y="262" width="8" height="186" fill="url(#steel)"/>
 <g stroke="#444" stroke-width=".8">
  <line x1="345" y1="265" x2="355" y2="268"/><line x1="345" y1="270" x2="355" y2="273"/><line x1="345" y1="275" x2="355" y2="278"/>
  <line x1="345" y1="432" x2="355" y2="435"/><line x1="345" y1="437" x2="355" y2="440"/><line x1="345" y1="442" x2="355" y2="445"/>
 </g>
</g>

<!-- 4 Cross plate -->
<g stroke="#111" stroke-width="1.4">
 <ellipse cx="350" cy="504" rx="98" ry="21" fill="#9aa0a6"/>
 <ellipse cx="350" cy="500" rx="98" ry="21" fill="url(#steel)"/>
 <ellipse cx="350" cy="500" rx="86" ry="17" fill="#fff" stroke-width="1"/>
 <g stroke-width="7" stroke="#a5abb1" stroke-linecap="round">
  <line x1="268" y1="500" x2="432" y2="500"/><line x1="350" y1="484" x2="350" y2="516"/>
 </g>
 <g fill="none" stroke-width=".8"><line x1="268" y1="496.5" x2="432" y2="496.5"/><line x1="268" y1="503.5" x2="432" y2="503.5"/></g>
 <ellipse cx="350" cy="500" rx="13" ry="5" fill="url(#steel)"/>
 <ellipse cx="350" cy="500" rx="4" ry="2" fill="#222"/>
</g>

<!-- 5 Mesh screen -->
<g stroke="#111" stroke-width="1.4">
 <ellipse cx="350" cy="560" rx="100" ry="22" fill="#eef"/>
 <rect x="250" y="535" width="200" height="50" fill="url(#mesh)" clip-path="url(#meshclip)" stroke="none"/>
 <ellipse cx="350" cy="560" rx="100" ry="22" fill="none" stroke-width="2.5" stroke="#667"/>
 <ellipse cx="350" cy="560" rx="10" ry="4" fill="#fff"/>
 <ellipse cx="350" cy="560" rx="4" ry="2" fill="#222"/>
</g>

<!-- 6 Spiral plate -->
<g stroke="#111" stroke-width="1.3">
 <ellipse cx="350" cy="624" rx="102" ry="23" fill="#9aa0a6"/>
 <ellipse cx="350" cy="620" rx="102" ry="23" fill="url(#steel)"/>
 <ellipse cx="350" cy="620" rx="104" ry="24" fill="none" stroke="#555" stroke-width="4" stroke-dasharray="2 2"/>
 <path d="M350 620 m0 -3 a8 3 0 1 1 -1 6 a20 6 0 1 1 3 -13 a34 9 0 1 1 -6 21 a50 12 0 1 1 8 -28 a66 15 0 1 1 -10 34 a82 18 0 1 1 10 -40" fill="none" stroke="#555" stroke-width="1.6"/>
 <ellipse cx="350" cy="620" rx="4" ry="2" fill="#222"/>
</g>

<!-- 7 End nut -->
<g stroke="#111" stroke-width="1.2">
 <path d="M338 668 L362 668 L362 684 L338 684 Z" fill="url(#steel)"/>
 <ellipse cx="350" cy="668" rx="12" ry="4" fill="#dde"/>
 <line x1="346" y1="668" x2="346" y2="684"/><line x1="354" y1="668" x2="354" y2="684"/>
</g>

<!-- 8 Glass beaker -->
<g stroke="#335" stroke-width="1.6">
 <path d="M240 752 L240 1000 Q240 1016 256 1016 L444 1016 Q460 1016 460 1000 L460 752" fill="url(#glass)"/>
 <ellipse cx="350" cy="752" rx="110" ry="18" fill="#e6f4fb" fill-opacity=".7"/>
 <path d="M260 742 Q234 738 226 744 Q234 756 242 760" fill="#e6f4fb" />
 <ellipse cx="350" cy="1008" rx="104" ry="8" fill="none" stroke="#9bc" stroke-width="1"/>
 <line x1="262" y1="780" x2="262" y2="990" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round" opacity=".8"/>
 <g stroke="#89a" stroke-width="1"><line x1="420" y1="820" x2="440" y2="820"/><line x1="428" y1="870" x2="440" y2="870"/><line x1="420" y1="920" x2="440" y2="920"/><line x1="428" y1="970" x2="440" y2="970"/></g>
</g>

<!-- 9 Frame / handle -->
<g stroke="#111" stroke-width="1.5">
 <!-- top band -->
 <path d="M232 1090 L468 1090 L468 1112 L232 1112 Z" fill="url(#steel)"/>
 <ellipse cx="350" cy="1090" rx="118" ry="16" fill="none"/>
 <!-- struts -->
 <rect x="238" y="1112" width="12" height="230" fill="url(#steel)"/>
 <rect x="450" y="1112" width="12" height="230" fill="url(#steel)"/>
 <rect x="344" y="1118" width="12" height="224" fill="url(#steel)" opacity=".85"/>
 <!-- base cup -->
 <path d="M232 1330 L468 1330 L468 1362 Q468 1374 452 1374 L248 1374 Q232 1374 232 1362 Z" fill="url(#steel)"/>
 <rect x="236" y="1374" width="30" height="8" fill="#333"/><rect x="434" y="1374" width="30" height="8" fill="#333"/>
 <!-- handle -->
 <path d="M468 1110 Q560 1110 562 1180 L562 1270 Q560 1330 468 1332 L468 1310 Q534 1306 536 1266 L536 1184 Q534 1134 468 1134 Z" fill="url(#black)"/>
</g>

<!-- assembly arrows -->
<g stroke="#c33" stroke-width="1.5" marker-end="url(#arr)">
 <line x1="200" y1="1060" x2="200" y2="1100"/>
 <line x1="200" y1="700" x2="200" y2="740"/>
</g>
<text x="190" y="1052" font-size="11" fill="#c33" text-anchor="end">beaker drops into frame</text>
<text x="190" y="692" font-size="11" fill="#c33" text-anchor="end">plunger into beaker</text>

<!-- labels -->
<g font-size="15" fill="#111">
 <g stroke="#333" stroke-width="1" fill="none">
  <polyline points="378,110 640,110"/>
  <polyline points="462,200 640,200"/>
  <polyline points="354,350 640,350"/>
  <polyline points="448,500 640,500"/>
  <polyline points="450,560 640,560"/>
  <polyline points="452,620 640,620"/>
  <polyline points="362,676 640,676"/>
  <polyline points="460,880 640,880"/>
  <polyline points="468,1100 640,1100"/>
  <polyline points="562,1220 640,1220"/>
 </g>
 <g fill="#111"><circle cx="378" cy="110" r="2.5"/><circle cx="462" cy="200" r="2.5"/><circle cx="354" cy="350" r="2.5"/><circle cx="448" cy="500" r="2.5"/><circle cx="450" cy="560" r="2.5"/><circle cx="452" cy="620" r="2.5"/><circle cx="362" cy="676" r="2.5"/><circle cx="460" cy="880" r="2.5"/><circle cx="468" cy="1100" r="2.5"/><circle cx="562" cy="1220" r="2.5"/></g>
 <text x="648" y="115"><tspan font-weight="bold">1</tspan>  Knob</text>
 <text x="648" y="205"><tspan font-weight="bold">2</tspan>  Lid</text>
 <text x="648" y="355"><tspan font-weight="bold">3</tspan>  Plunger rod</text>
 <text x="648" y="505"><tspan font-weight="bold">4</tspan>  Cross plate</text>
 <text x="648" y="565"><tspan font-weight="bold">5</tspan>  Mesh screen</text>
 <text x="648" y="625"><tspan font-weight="bold">6</tspan>  Spiral plate</text>
 <text x="648" y="681"><tspan font-weight="bold">7</tspan>  End nut</text>
 <text x="648" y="885"><tspan font-weight="bold">8</tspan>  Glass beaker</text>
 <text x="648" y="1105"><tspan font-weight="bold">9</tspan>  Frame</text>
 <text x="648" y="1225"><tspan font-weight="bold">10</tspan> Handle</text>
</g>
<rect x="628" y="470" width="190" height="176" fill="none" stroke="#c33" stroke-dasharray="5 4"/>
<text x="723" y="462" font-size="12" fill="#c33" text-anchor="middle">Filter assembly (4–6)</text>
</svg>
